goal: Implement accepted modern/simple shared action UI in narrow conversation panel and broad/full presentation with complete proposal and recovery continuity.
approach: One shared controller, immutable pure editing/presentation models, effectful host/DOM adapters, responsive list-first presentation and generated inline SVG assets. Native Profile author artifact; no runtime kernel or ledger claim.

requirements.statement: The UI shall preserve all existing action semantics, shared actionCall authority and exact-operation replay guarantees.
requirements.rationale: Accepted requirements-plan revision native-author-20261003-3 UAC-001 through UAC-010.

requirements.statement: When a refresh, view switch, resize or host mode update occurs, the UI shall preserve every dirty editing value, selected editor, caret/focus, review and recovery state.
requirements.rationale: Accepted requirements-plan revision native-author-20261003-3 UAC-001 through UAC-010.

requirements.statement: While a selected dirty action is excluded from the current list, a named retained-proposal entry shall remain reachable without claiming current-view membership.
requirements.rationale: Accepted requirements-plan revision native-author-20261003-3 UAC-001 through UAC-010.

requirements.statement: If a write response is missing, the UI shall retain the exact request and expose receipt checking and identical retry without a trapping modal or duplicate new write.
requirements.rationale: Accepted requirements-plan revision native-author-20261003-3 UAC-001 through UAC-010.

requirements.statement: When a supported display request completes, the UI shall use the acknowledged resulting mode and retain proposal state; unsupported modes shall not be advertised as working.
requirements.rationale: Accepted requirements-plan revision native-author-20261003-3 UAC-001 through UAC-010.

requirements.statement: The UI shall offer named accessible controls with coherent icons, compact list-first hierarchy, light/dark themes and narrow/broad responsive presentation.
requirements.rationale: Accepted requirements-plan revision native-author-20261003-3 UAC-001 through UAC-010.

requirements.statement: When review opens or closes, the UI shall contain modal focus, permit Escape/Back without saving, provide reachable long-preview controls and return meaningful focus.
requirements.rationale: Accepted requirements-plan revision native-author-20261003-3 UAC-001 through UAC-010.

adrs.title: Preserve proposal state independently of responsive/host presentation
adrs.context: DOM-only parent/date/status inputs and replaced list rows lose editor state; requested host display support requires explicit capability protocol.
adrs.decision: Typed pure proposal/presentation state plus separate host-context subscription and effectful keyed DOM adapter. Use MCP Apps inline/fullscreen and global/thread metadata, not invented sidebar mode.
consequences: No domain/schema migration; internal typed interfaces evolve together.
Host context and write uncertainty remain independent.
Actual ChatGPT host/cache/auth acceptance remains unexecuted until requested deployment.

alternatives.option: DOM-only drafts and width-derived full mode
alternatives.why_not: Refresh drops values; width does not prove host acknowledgment.

alternatives.option: Separate sidebar/full apps or raster icon sheets
alternatives.why_not: Duplicates state paths; runtime-size raster legibility weaker than generated currentColor SVG.

decision_dispositions.rationale: Approved requirements native-author-20261003-3 reversible list-first default.
Fetched official OpenAI resource/entrypoint docs and primary MCP Apps protocol on 2026-10-03.

implementation_contracts.subject: Pure editing state and application orchestration

decision_rules.outcome: Own all fields in typed pure Draft: title, exact notes, order, flagged, parent_id, due_at, lifecycle status; also typed UI-only deferDate/deferUntil, explicit timezone, with independently dirty field groups. Preserve raw incomplete input until validation/preview. Persisted patch contains only explicitly edited fields. Date-only/timezone helpers never leak into edit payload; defer/status remain their existing operation kinds.
decision_rules.rationale: Implements accepted requirements with explicit responsibility boundary.

decision_rules.outcome: Merge untouched values from current snapshot; retain dirty values and original revision/base for comparison. Never infer that retained proposal has current-view membership. Selected dirty action outside filtered list remains in a separate named retained-proposal route; absent action stays visible as retained proposal and cannot mutate until a fresh known target is resolved.
decision_rules.rationale: Implements accepted requirements with explicit responsibility boundary.

decision_rules.outcome: Clear only acknowledged submitted fields matching the proposal version captured before write; do not discard unrelated unsaved lifecycle/date/editor groups. A modal review holds immutable preview with expectedRevision, not newly recomputed payload.
decision_rules.rationale: Implements accepted requirements with explicit responsibility boundary.

decision_rules.condition: Confirmation, refresh, conflict or missing write response
decision_rules.outcome: Close review before write; clear stale reviewed state; retain exact sent operation ID/arguments on unknown. Preserve latest saved correction and dirty proposal on conflict; require fresh preview before another confirmed write. result not_observed stays unknown. No new operation on identical retry; navigation, receipt check and display remain usable while conflicting writes are blocked.
decision_rules.rationale: Implements accepted requirements with explicit responsibility boundary.

implementation_contracts.subject: Typed host display bridge

decision_rules.outcome: Declare appCapabilities.availableDisplayModes=[inline,fullscreen]. Consume initialize result.hostContext. Add typed separate subscribeContext alongside snapshot subscription. ui/notifications/host-context-changed params is direct partial context; merge valid supplied fields without clearing omitted ones. Validate mode enum and availableDisplayModes arrays. Never derive mode from iframe width or invent sidebar wire value.
decision_rules.rationale: Implements accepted requirements with explicit responsibility boundary.

decision_rules.outcome: Check target in current hostContext.availableDisplayModes and declared app modes. Send ui/request-display-mode {mode:target}; result {mode:actual} is authority and can differ. Pending display is independent from mutation busy/unknown. Host notification later is authoritative; concurrent notification/request handling must not apply a demonstrably older response over a newer context. Error/invalid result preserves acknowledged mode and reports display failure only.
decision_rules.rationale: Implements accepted requirements with explicit responsibility boundary.

decision_rules.condition: Standalone Board or host omits support
decision_rules.outcome: Board preserves same iframe/controller lifetime and identifies Web presentation through hostInfo; advertise actual full-window Web context only, not fictional ChatGPT panel support. Generic missing context renders responsive layout and hidden/unavailable mode affordance. No browser fullscreen substitute masquerades as host fullscreen.
decision_rules.rationale: Implements accepted requirements with explicit responsibility boundary.

decision_rules.outcome: Existing list/open tool gets _meta[openai/ui].entrypoints=[{type:global},{type:thread}] and same registered resourceUri; resource contents advertise _meta[openai/ui].availableDisplayModes=[inline,fullscreen]. Existing security/CSP/access retained, no new site/plugin. Thread is conversation side panel, global launches from sidebar fullscreen; standard modes remain inline/fullscreen.
decision_rules.rationale: Implements accepted requirements with explicit responsibility boundary.

implementation_contracts.subject: Responsive visual and DOM composition

decision_rules.outcome: Use labeled compact navigation, current scope heading/count, concise read rows with named select/complete controls, explicit direct flag and real lifecycle/date badges; secondary selected editor inline for narrow and companion panel broad. Technical IDs/revisions live only in collapsed diagnostics. Preserve each current scope meaning and exact original capture fields.
decision_rules.rationale: Implements accepted requirements with explicit responsibility boundary.

decision_rules.condition: DOM updates from snapshot/controller or mode
decision_rules.outcome: Prefer stable keyed editor nodes/patching; otherwise capture and restore typed effect snapshot (data-focus-key, selectionStart/end/direction, open details, scroll) only where node remains meaningful. Input events update pure state without full destructive re-render and preserve IME composition. Store selected action and expansion state beyond filtered row existence; capture fields retain title/raw notes across render. Complete unsaved guard includes captureTitle and all draft groups.
decision_rules.rationale: Implements accepted requirements with explicit responsibility boundary.

decision_rules.outcome: Use native dialog with max-height bounded to viewport, overflow scrolling, reachable Confirm/Back; Escape prevents save, clears reviewed state, restores invoker or retained-proposal control if row vanished. Keep dialog open/content stable through host mode updates. Display control reachable within modal or named Back. On confirm close modal before pending/unknown recovery, expose named recovery controls and meaningful focus.
decision_rules.rationale: Implements accepted requirements with explicit responsibility boundary.

decision_rules.outcome: Generate original consistent 24x24 inline SVG line icons (currentColor, shared stroke width/caps, aria-hidden and focusable=false) via code generation; no raster shrinking or new dependency. Icons accompany visible text/accessible names. CSS uses restrained tokens, comfortable hit targets, visible focus, contrast both themes, reduced-motion and no page horizontal scroll at 320px/zoom. Long titles/raw text wrap. Genuine generated icon source plus visual verification fulfills request without requiring raster imagegen.
decision_rules.rationale: Implements accepted requirements with explicit responsibility boundary.
